title: Instalacija klastera kubeadm-om i HA kontrolna ravan
summary: Podizanje klastera sa kubeadm init (flagovi i v1beta4 konfiguracija), instalacija CNI-ja, kubeadm join za worker i control plane čvorove, kubeadm reset i HA topologije sa load balancerom.
title_en: Installing a cluster with kubeadm and an HA control plane
summary_en: Bootstrapping a cluster with kubeadm init (flags and v1beta4 configuration), installing a CNI, kubeadm join for worker and control plane nodes, kubeadm reset, and HA topologies with a load balancer.
